patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero sections feature large, impactful typography on one side balanced by a dynamic image or video on the other, often with a diagonal cut-out effect.
Headlines utilize overwhelmingly large, bold, sans-serif display typography to create a strong visual hierarchy and immediate impact, contrasting with smaller, legible body text.
Vibrant, full-bleed gradient backgrounds (red to orange) are used for high-energy sections, providing a strong contrast to the clean off-white and black content blocks.

Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience. The hero image appears to have a subtle parallax or sticky effect as content scrolls over it.

Full-width sections with distinct background colors or gradients are used to clearly delineate content blocks and highlight key messages or data points, often featuring large numbers or bold statements.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations (likely using locomotive-scroll as hinted) to progressively reveal content. Elements within sections fade in and subtly slide upwards as they become visible in the viewport, creating a smooth, dynamic flow. The hero image utilizes a sticky or parallax effect, allowing subsequent content to scroll over it while the image itself moves at a slower pace or remains fixed.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a strong, impactful presence, complemented by clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to sharp corners on most elements, with primary call-to-action buttons having a slightly more rounded appearance.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing, particularly in hero and feature sections, allowing large typography and imagery to breathe. Tighter spacing is used in the footer and client logo sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, bold display typography combined with vibrant, full-bleed gradient sections and high-impact, close-up photography creates an energetic and modern feel. The sophisticated scroll-triggered reveals add a layer of dynamism, making the content feel engaging and progressive.
